description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pelwehera, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310012
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their numbers, locations, and ownership details (all listed as "The State"). The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
